summary: Checked the fix for the server-rendered / header when a user is signed in. Everything passed. curl: no cookie, __client_uat=0 and __client_uat_x=0 show auth-button 'Sign up / Log in'. __client_uat=<ts> and __client_uat_<suffix>=<ts> show header-dashboard-link 'My dashboard' (href /dashboard). With lang=fr it shows 'Mon tableau de bord'. city-greeting 'hello ottawa' is always present. The Cache-Control response header is 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. UI (Playwright, Clerk sign-in ticket for the member user): landed on /dashboard. Clicking header-logo-link, page.goto('/') and a new tab in the same context all showed 'My dashboard' and no auth-button. /?lang=fr showed 'Mon tableau de bord'. Clicking 'My dashboard' opened /dashboard with 'Coming up'. After signing out through the UserButton (redirected to /sign-in), both __client_uat cookies were '0' and / showed 'Sign up / Log in' again. A fresh signed-out context showed 'Sign up / Log in'. Unit tests: 29 passed.

issues: 'My dashboard' is a filled pill button on the server-rendered / but plain text next to the UserButton on /dashboard. This is a small visual inconsistency.

critical_code_review_comments: looks_signed_in() only gives a display hint. If a session has expired but the __client_uat cookie is stale and non-zero, / shows 'My dashboard' and the SPA then redirects to sign-in. This is acceptable.

Cookies on the preview domain after sign-in: __client_uat, __client_uat_lEHIiybv (domain .aol-local-courses--2x60l6by.preview.emergentagent.com), __session, __session_lEHIiybv, __clerk_db_jwt, __clerk_db_jwt_lEHIiybv, clerk_active_context. So the cookie the fix depends on is present.
seed_data_creation: None. Used only the existing member test user, through single-use sign-in tickets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use backend/tests/make_ticket.py <user_id> to create Clerk sign-in tickets, then open /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<t>. To sign out: click .cl-userButtonTrigger, then the 'Sign out' button (it is not a role=menuitem).
